name: SART Proximal Operator
definition: A tomography reconstruction method that modifies the standard SART algorithm to incorporate a proximal operator, allowing for the inclusion of prior information (input estimate u) and regularization. It solves the system by iterating on variables y and x, where x is the volume reconstruction and y is an auxiliary variable related to the data fidelity term.
summary: The SART Proximal Operator is an iterative tomographic reconstruction method that extends standard SART by incorporating a proximal term to enforce prior information or regularization.
